back.es: tras = after; behind (preposition). Example: After dinner, we watched a movie.
back.example: After dinner, we watched a movie.

note: "Día tras día" is the fixed phrase, so the prompt works, but in casual speech Latin Americans usually say "después de la cena" and "tras" sounds a bit formal, so the editor might mention that "después de" is the everyday way to say "after".
